blocks.text: Past its usual noontime airing, the "It's Showtime" studio erupted in cheers late Saturday night as fans celebrated the victory of "Tawag ng Tanghalan: School Showdown" grand champion Carmelle Collado at the first-ever Eurovision Song Contest Asia in Bangkok, Thailand.
